searches.reason: Build an inference-aligned stress-test suite that distinguishes reliance on recent intent from broad historical affinity. Use paired training-prefix targets, fixed candidates, recent-deletion versus count-matched deletion, and latest-item-preserving shuffles. Seek identity controls, injected-fault tests for MASK/readout errors, and user-clustered uncertainty; interpret perturbations as sensitivity rather than causal intent.

searches.reason: Connect qualitative rejection reasons to measurable ranking failures. Investigate evidence-linked annotation of the twenty training users’ recommendations for explicit willingness to choose, duplication, compatibility, quantity, and mood mismatch. Use only supplied feedback, histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps; retain unknown judgments, measure annotation agreement and coverage, and avoid inferring latent traits or treating missing interactions as rejection.

searches.reason: Develop an auditable explanation of how supervision reaches one BERT4Rec network. Seek controls that separate context distribution, target normalization, and allocation effects without training auxiliary predictors or changing the host evaluator.
